column1: # provision.tsv — the mounts, engines, policies and cert roles this release
# adds to a secrets store an earlier release initialised (geekdojo/geekdojo-brain#805,
# #1084; ADR-0010 S9). rasputin-store-provision.service reads it on every
# start of the store and adds only what is missing. Nothing it finds present
# is changed, except a policy whose text differs from this image's, and
# nothing is ever removed.
# init.json beside this file is FROZEN from the store-arming release on: a
# store runs it once, on its first start, so an item added there would reach
# fresh stores only. A later release adds mounts and roles HERE, and a fresh
# store gets them here too, from the same provisioner, within its limits.
# Two exceptions, each allowed by a dated ADR-0010 amendment, reach only the
# stores initialised from the release that carries them:
#   the audited job-id header request (geekdojo/geekdojo-brain#802):
#   https://github.com/geekdojo/geekdojo-brain/blob/main/projects/rasputin/adr/0010-secrets-store.md#the-initjson-job-header-exception-802
#   the author identity, policy-rasputin-author and role-rasputin-author
#   (geekdojo/geekdojo-brain#1084, amended 2026-11-15), for stores
#   initialised from release 2026.11.3 on; the engine, policy and role items
#   below are added through it:
#   https://github.com/geekdojo/geekdojo-brain/blob/main/projects/rasputin/adr/0010-secrets-store.md#the-initjson-author-amendment-1084
# One item per line, its fields separated by one TAB:
#   mount<TAB><name>               a kv-v2 mount at <name>, in rasputin-rel-*
#   role<TAB><name><TAB><policy>   a cert role <name> trusting the store CA,
#                                  admitting only the CommonName <name>: in
#                                  rasputin-rel-* binding rasputin-bindable,
#                                  or in rasputin-app-* binding a
#                                  rasputin-app-* policy
#   engine<TAB><name><TAB>transit  a Transit engine at <name>, in rasputin-app-*
#   policy<TAB><name>              the policy <name>, in rasputin-app-*, its
#                                  text from
#                                  /usr/share/rasputin/openbao-policy/<name>.hcl
# A name is the namespace followed by lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
# The rasputin-rel-* items are added as the store's provisioner, the
# rasputin-app-* ones as rasputin-author. Anything else refuses the whole
# file, and the run is recorded failed. Lines starting with # and blank lines
# are skipped.
# A store initialised before release 2026.11.3 has no rasputin-author role:
# its rasputin-app-* items are skipped and the run is recorded unchanged, with
# a sentence saying so and author=absent. The api then rolls that store
# forward to this release's init.json (geekdojo/geekdojo-brain#1132), and the
# next start adds these items through the author it now has.
# This release adds the api's app-key engine, its policy and its role
# (geekdojo/geekdojo-brain#1084).
engine
policy
